gloss: Shinto shrine; imperial prince or princess

definitions.explanation: A shrine, especially an important one; mostly in compounds and place names such as お{宮|みや} and {宮参|みやまい}り.

definitions.gloss: imperial prince or princess; member of a princely house
definitions.explanation: A title for members of the imperial family who head or belong to a branch house, as in {秋篠宮|あきしののみや}; honorifically {宮様|みやさま}.

examples.japanese: お{宮|みや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{宮参|みやまい}り→お宮参り：05925_omiyamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We took the baby for its first shrine visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宮|みや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A festival is held every autumn at the village shrine.

examples.japanese: {宮様|みやさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{秋篠宮|あきしののみや}{家|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Akishino family's event was reported.

examples.japanese: {宮家|みやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The shrinking number of princely houses has become an issue for the imperial family.

notes:
Sense 1 is mostly found as お{宮|みや} and in compounds; the everyday word for a shrine is ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧. Many place names contain it ({宇都宮|うつのみや}, {西宮|にしのみや}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{宮参|みやまい}り→お宮参り：05925_omiyamairi⟧: a newborn's first shrine visit
- {宮様|みやさま}: (honorific) prince, princess
- {宮家|みやけ}: princely house (branch of the imperial family)
- ⟦{宮内庁|くないちょう}→宮内庁：31802_kunaichou⟧: Imperial Household Agency (here the reading is く)
